mapper.insert: INSERT INTO places (id, user_id, name, city, address, category, position, coordinate_status, coordinate_source) VALUES (#{id}, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', #{request.name}, #{request.city}, #{request.address}, #{request.category}, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{request.longitude}, #{request.latitude}), 4326)NULL, 'user_confirmed''pending', 'manual user input'NULL)
